entries.source: Existing Site labels and legend now use matching symbols.

drafts.zu: Ibalazwe lomlando le-Existing Site manje lisebenzisa izimpawu ezifanayo kumalebula ezindawo nasokhiye webalazwe.
drafts.st: Mmapa wa kgale wa Existing Site jwale o sebedisa matshwao a tshwanang mabitsong a dibaka le senotlolong sa mmapa.
drafts.ts: Mepe wa khale wa Existing Site sweswi wu tirhisa swikombiso leswi fanaka eka mavito ya tindhawu ni le ka xikombo xa mepe.
drafts.ve: Mapa wa kale wa Existing Site zwino u shumisa zwiga zwi fanaho kha madzina a fhethu na kha khii ya mapa.
